title: 台灣光子源 TPS
subcategoryTitle: 大型加速器與光源設施
summary: 以 TPS 的 48 台 1.19 T 偶極與每圈 853 keV 的輻射損失為起點，理解 24 單元 DBA 晶格如何達到 1.6 nm·rad 的發射度，再把 240 台四極的磁中心對準、KEKB 型 500 MHz 超導腔、束流壽命預算、250 Hz 快速軌道回授、同隧道 496.8 m 增能環與真空內波盪器整合成可交接的 3 GeV 光源工程。
summaryEn: Starting from TPS's 48 dipoles at 1.19 T and its 853 keV energy loss per turn, see how a 24-cell DBA lattice reaches 1.6 nm·rad emittance, then integrate magnetic-centre alignment of 240 quadrupoles, KEKB-type 500 MHz superconducting cavities, the lifetime budget, 250 Hz fast orbit feedback, a 496.8 m booster in the same tunnel and in-vacuum undulators into a transferable 3 GeV light-source record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失」與「DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn" and "DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」如何決定台灣光子源 TPS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “48 dipoles at 1.19 T” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Photon Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TPS 儲存環把 3 GeV 電子以 48 台偶極磁鐵彎轉一圈，每台彎 7.5°、長約 1.1 m。電子在偏轉時沿切線方向發出同步輻射，光譜由臨界能量 E_c 描述，E_c 與 E³/ρ 成正比；每圈損失的能量 U₀ 與 E⁴/ρ 成正比，必須由射頻腔每圈補回。500 mA 的儲存電流使偶極輻射功率達數百 kW，這些功率幾乎全部打在真空室下游的光子吸收器與光束線前端上，因此臨界能量與 U₀ 同時決定了光源的光譜、射頻功率需求與熱負載設計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The TPS storage ring bends 3 GeV electrons around the circle with 48 dipoles, each deflecting 7.5° over about 1.1 m. While bending, electrons emit synchrotron radiation tangentially with a spectrum characterized by the critical energy E_c, proportional to E³/ρ; the energy lost per turn U₀ scales as E⁴/ρ and must be restored by the RF cavities every turn. At 500 mA stored current the dipole radiation reaches hundreds of kilowatts, almost all of it landing on photon absorbers downstream in the chambers and on beamline front ends, so the critical energy and U₀ together set the spectrum, the RF power demand and the heat-load design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “48 dipoles at 1.19 T”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：先由磁剛度求彎轉半徑與偶極場，再算臨界能量與每圈輻射損失。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: First derive bending radius and field from rigidity, then the critical energy and loss per turn.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「臨界能量就是光源能提供的最高光子能量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The critical energy is the highest photon energy the source can deliver." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “48 dipoles at 1.19 T”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失
knowledge.titleEn: Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn
knowledge.text: TPS 儲存環把 3 GeV 電子以 48 台偶極磁鐵彎轉一圈，每台彎 7.5°、長約 1.1 m。電子在偏轉時沿切線方向發出同步輻射，光譜由臨界能量 E_c 描述，E_c 與 E³/ρ 成正比；每圈損失的能量 U₀ 與 E⁴/ρ 成正比，必須由射頻腔每圈補回。
knowledge.textEn: The TPS storage ring bends 3 GeV electrons around the circle with 48 dipoles, each deflecting 7.5° over about 1.1 m. While bending, electrons emit synchrotron radiation tangentially with a spectrum characterized by the critical energy E_c, proportional to E³/ρ; the energy lost per turn U₀ scales as E⁴/ρ and must be restored by the RF cavities every turn.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：臨界能量就是光源能提供的最高光子能量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The critical energy is the highest photon energy the source can deliver. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn" is correct?
options: 臨界能量就是光源能提供的最高光子能量。
TPS 儲存環把 3 GeV 電子以 48 台偶極磁鐵彎轉一圈，每台彎 7.5°、長約 1.1 m。
發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。
optionsEn: The critical energy is the highest photon energy the source can deliver.
The TPS storage ring bends 3 GeV electrons around the circle with 48 dipoles, each deflecting 7.5° over about 1.1 m.
Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance.
quiz.explanation: TPS 儲存環把 3 GeV 電子以 48 台偶極磁鐵彎轉一圈，每台彎 7.5°、長約 1.1 m。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The TPS storage ring bends 3 GeV electrons around the circle with 48 dipoles, each deflecting 7.5° over about 1.1 m. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “48 dipoles at 1.19 T” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：先由磁剛度求彎轉半徑與偶極場，再算臨界能量與每圈輻射損失。Bρ = 3.3356×3 = 10.01 T·m；θ = 2π/48 = 7.5°、L = 1.1 m → ρ = 8.40 m，B = 10.01/8.40 ≈ 1.19 T。E_c = 2.218E³/ρ = 2.218×27/8.40 ≈ 7.13 keV；U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/8.40 ≈ 853 keV。500 mA 時 P = 853 kV×0.5 A ≈ 427 kW，水平每 mrad 約 427 kW/6283 mrad ≈ 68 W。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: First derive bending radius and field from rigidity, then the critical energy and loss per turn. Bρ = 3.3356×3 = 10.01 T·m; with θ = 2π/48 = 7.5° and L = 1.1 m, ρ = 8.40 m and B = 10.01/8.40 ≈ 1.19 T. E_c = 2.218E³/ρ = 2.218×27/8.40 ≈ 7.13 keV; U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/8.40 ≈ 853 keV. At 500 mA the power is P = 853 kV×0.5 A ≈ 427 kW, about 427 kW/6283 mrad ≈ 68 W per horizontal milliradian. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以射頻系統的前向功率減反射功率、扣除腔壁損耗求得束流吸收功率，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；量測同步相位隨電流的變化反推每圈損失；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜形狀，與 7.13 keV 臨界能量的通用函數比較；以吸收器冷卻水的進出水溫差與流量核對實際熱負載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Derive beam-absorbed power from RF forward minus reflected power less cavity wall loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); infer the loss per turn from the synchronous-phase shift with current; scan the bending-magnet beamline spectrum with a monochromator and compare with the universal curve for a 7.13 keV critical energy; check the real heat load from absorber cooling-water temperature rise and flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: First derive bending radius and field from rigidity, then the critical energy and loss per turn. Bρ = 3.3356×3 = 10.01 T·m; with θ = 2π/48 = 7.5° and L = 1.1 m, ρ = 8.40 m and B = 10.01/8.40 ≈ 1.19 T. E_c = 2.218E³/ρ = 2.218×27/8.40 ≈ 7.13 keV; U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/8.40 ≈ 853 keV. At 500 mA the power is P = 853 kV×0.5 A ≈ 427 kW, about 427 kW/6283 mrad ≈ 68 W per horizontal milliradian.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn", which statement holds?
options: 超導腔幾乎沒有損耗，因此不需要做低溫功率預算。
回授頻寬越高越好，可以把所有雜訊壓掉。
先由磁剛度求彎轉半徑與偶極場，再算臨界能量與每圈輻射損失。
optionsEn: Superconducting cavities barely dissipate, so no cryogenic power budget is needed.
Higher feedback bandwidth is always better and removes all noise.
First derive bending radius and field from rigidity, then the critical energy and loss per turn.
quiz.explanation: 先由磁剛度求彎轉半徑與偶極場，再算臨界能量與每圈輻射損失。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: First derive bending radius and field from rigidity, then the critical energy and loss per turn. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “48 dipoles at 1.19 T” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以射頻系統的前向功率減反射功率、扣除腔壁損耗求得束流吸收功率，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；量測同步相位隨電流的變化反推每圈損失；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜形狀，與 7.13 keV 臨界能量的通用函數比較；以吸收器冷卻水的進出水溫差與流量核對實際熱負載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Derive beam-absorbed power from RF forward minus reflected power less cavity wall loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); infer the loss per turn from the synchronous-phase shift with current; scan the bending-magnet beamline spectrum with a monochromator and compare with the universal curve for a 7.13 keV critical energy; check the real heat load from absorber cooling-water temperature rise and flow. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：光子吸收器位置偏移或冷卻水流量不足時，輻射扇打到未冷卻的真空室壁或法蘭，局部溫升造成光子激發脫附與壓力暴增，嚴重時法蘭密封失效漏氣；電流愈高問題愈明顯，常在提升電流試運轉時才暴露。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A misplaced photon absorber or insufficient cooling flow lets the radiation fan strike uncooled chamber walls or flanges, local heating drives photon-stimulated desorption and pressure bursts, and in severe cases a flange seal fails and leaks; the higher the current the worse it gets, so it often appears only during current ramp-up trials.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以射頻系統的前向功率減反射功率、扣除腔壁損耗求得束流吸收功率，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；量測同步相位隨電流的變化反推每圈損失；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜形狀，與 7.13 keV 臨界能量的通用函數比較；以吸收器冷卻水的進出水溫差與流量核對實際熱負載。
knowledge.textEn: Derive beam-absorbed power from RF forward minus reflected power less cavity wall loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); infer the loss per turn from the synchronous-phase shift with current; scan the bending-magnet beamline spectrum with a monochromator and compare with the universal curve for a 7.13 keV critical energy; check the real heat load from absorber cooling-water temperature rise and flow.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn"?
options: 以射頻系統的前向功率減反射功率、扣除腔壁損耗求得束流吸收功率，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
頂注只是操作上的方便，對光束線的熱穩定沒有影響。
optionsEn: Derive beam-absorbed power from RF forward minus reflected power less cavity wall loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss).
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Top-up is merely an operational convenience with no effect on beamline thermal stability.
quiz.explanation: 以射頻系統的前向功率減反射功率、扣除腔壁損耗求得束流吸收功率，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；量測同步相位隨電流的變化反推每圈損失；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜形狀，與 7.13 keV 臨界能量的通用函數比較；以吸收器冷卻水的進出水溫差與流量核對實際熱負載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Derive beam-absorbed power from RF forward minus reflected power less cavity wall loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); infer the loss per turn from the synchronous-phase shift with current; scan the bending-magnet beamline spectrum with a monochromator and compare with the universal curve for a 7.13 keV critical energy; check the real heat load from absorber cooling-water temperature rise and flow. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “48 dipoles at 1.19 T” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 光子吸收器位置偏移或冷卻水流量不足時，輻射扇打到未冷卻的真空室壁或法蘭，局部溫升造成光子激發脫附與壓力暴增，嚴重時法蘭密封失效漏氣；電流愈高問題愈明顯，常在提升電流試運轉時才暴露。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A misplaced photon absorber or insufficient cooling flow lets the radiation fan strike uncooled chamber walls or flanges, local heating drives photon-stimulated desorption and pressure bursts, and in severe cases a flange seal fails and leaks; the higher the current the worse it gets, so it often appears only during current ramp-up trials. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：500 mA 的儲存電流使偶極輻射功率達數百 kW，這些功率幾乎全部打在真空室下游的光子吸收器與光束線前端上，因此臨界能量與 U₀ 同時決定了光源的光譜、射頻功率需求與熱負載設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At 500 mA stored current the dipole radiation reaches hundreds of kilowatts, almost all of it landing on photon absorbers downstream in the chambers and on beamline front ends, so the critical energy and U₀ together set the spectrum, the RF power demand and the heat-load design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「臨界能量就是光源能提供的最高光子能量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The critical energy is the highest photon energy the source can deliver." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 光子吸收器位置偏移或冷卻水流量不足時，輻射扇打到未冷卻的真空室壁或法蘭，局部溫升造成光子激發脫附與壓力暴增，嚴重時法蘭密封失效漏氣；電流愈高問題愈明顯，常在提升電流試運轉時才暴露。
knowledge.textEn: A misplaced photon absorber or insufficient cooling flow lets the radiation fan strike uncooled chamber walls or flanges, local heating drives photon-stimulated desorption and pressure bursts, and in severe cases a flange seal fails and leaks; the higher the current the worse it gets, so it often appears only during current ramp-up trials.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
光子吸收器位置偏移或冷卻水流量不足時，輻射扇打到未冷卻的真空室壁或法蘭，局部溫升造成光子激發脫附與壓力暴增，嚴重時法蘭密封失效漏氣。
發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

A misplaced photon absorber or insufficient cooling flow lets the radiation fan strike uncooled chamber walls or flanges, local heating drives photon-stimulated desorption and pressure bursts, and in severe cases a flange seal fails and leaks.
Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance.
quiz.explanation: 光子吸收器位置偏移或冷卻水流量不足時，輻射扇打到未冷卻的真空室壁或法蘭，局部溫升造成光子激發脫附與壓力暴增，嚴重時法蘭密封失效漏氣；電流愈高問題愈明顯，常在提升電流試運轉時才暴露。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A misplaced photon absorber or insufficient cooling flow lets the radiation fan strike uncooled chamber walls or flanges, local heating drives photon-stimulated desorption and pressure bursts, and in severe cases a flange seal fails and leaks; the higher the current the worse it gets, so it often appears only during current ramp-up trials. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「24 個雙彎消色散單元」如何決定台灣光子源 TPS的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “24 double-bend achromat cells” determines the key performance of “Taiwan Photon Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儲存環的水平發射度來自量子激發與輻射阻尼的平衡，與 γ²θ³ 成正比，因此增加偶極數、減小每台彎角是降低發射度的主要手段。TPS 採 24 單元雙彎消色散（DBA）晶格，共 48 台偶極，留出 6 段 12 m 與 18 段 7 m 的直線段給插件磁鐵與射頻腔。嚴格消色散時直線段色散為零，但發射度有理論下限；TPS 允許直線段帶少量色散，把發射度壓到低於嚴格 DBA 下限的 1.6 nm·rad，代價是光源點的有效束流尺寸要加上色散與能量分散的貢獻。垂直發射度 16 pm·rad，對應約 1% 的耦合。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「24 個雙彎消色散單元」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal emittance comes from the balance of quantum excitation and radiation damping and scales as γ²θ³, so more dipoles with smaller bends are the main route to low emittance. TPS uses a 24-cell double-bend achromat (DBA) with 48 dipoles, leaving six 12 m and eighteen 7 m straights for insertion devices and RF cavities. A strict achromat keeps zero dispersion in the straights but has a theoretical emittance floor; TPS allows slight dispersion in the straights to reach 1.6 nm·rad, below that strict-DBA floor, at the cost of adding a dispersion-times-energy-spread term to the effective source size. The vertical emittance of 16 pm·rad corresponds to about 1% coupling. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “24 double-bend achromat cells”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：嚴格消色散的 DBA 發射度下限為 ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The strict-achromat DBA emittance floor is ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「24 個雙彎消色散單元」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “24 double-bend achromat cells”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度
knowledge.titleEn: DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance

knowledge.textEn: Horizontal emittance comes from the balance of quantum excitation and radiation damping and scales as γ²θ³, so more dipoles with smaller bends are the main route to low emittance. TPS uses a 24-cell double-bend achromat (DBA) with 48 dipoles, leaving six 12 m and eighteen 7 m straights for insertion devices and RF cavities.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance" is correct?
options: 發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。
四極磁鐵只要梯度正確，位置偏一點也沒關係。
儲存環的水平發射度來自量子激發與輻射阻尼的平衡，與 γ²θ³ 成正比，因此增加偶極數、減小每台彎角是降低發射度的主要手段。
optionsEn: Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance.
If a quadrupole's gradient is correct, a small position offset does not matter.
Horizontal emittance comes from the balance of quantum excitation and radiation damping and scales as γ²θ³, so more dipoles with smaller bends are the main route to low emittance.
quiz.explanation: 儲存環的水平發射度來自量子激發與輻射阻尼的平衡，與 γ²θ³ 成正比，因此增加偶極數、減小每台彎角是降低發射度的主要手段。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Horizontal emittance comes from the balance of quantum excitation and radiation damping and scales as γ²θ³, so more dipoles with smaller bends are the main route to low emittance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「24 個雙彎消色散單元」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “24 double-bend achromat cells” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：嚴格消色散的 DBA 發射度下限為 ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x)。γ = 5871、θ = 0.1309 rad、C_q = 3.832×10⁻¹³ m、J_x = 1：ε ≈ 3.832×10⁻¹³×3.45×10⁷×2.24×10⁻³/15.49 ≈ 1.91 nm·rad。TPS 實際 1.6 nm·rad 對應因子 F = ε/(C_qγ²θ³) ≈ 0.054，介於 DBA 下限 0.0645 與 TME 0.0215 之間；ε_y/ε_x = 16 pm/1.6 nm = 1%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The strict-achromat DBA emittance floor is ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x). With γ = 5871, θ = 0.1309 rad, C_q = 3.832×10⁻¹³ m and J_x = 1, ε ≈ 3.832×10⁻¹³×3.45×10⁷×2.24×10⁻³/15.49 ≈ 1.91 nm·rad. The actual 1.6 nm·rad corresponds to F = ε/(C_qγ²θ³) ≈ 0.054, between the DBA floor of 0.0645 and the TME value of 0.0215; ε_y/ε_x = 16 pm/1.6 nm = 1%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以軌道響應矩陣擬合（LOCO 類方法）求實際 β 函數與色散，再用 X 光針孔相機量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推發射度並與 1.6 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測直線段色散，確認其大小符合設計；以斜四極掃描量測耦合與垂直發射度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit the orbit-response matrix (LOCO-type analysis) to obtain actual beta functions and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole camera and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 1.6 nm·rad; measure straight-section dispersion with RF-frequency steps to confirm its design value; scan skew quadrupoles to measure coupling and vertical emittance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 嚴格消色散的 DBA 發射度下限為 ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x)。γ = 5871、θ = 0.1309 rad、C_q = 3.832×10⁻¹³ m、J_x = 1：ε ≈ 3.832×10⁻¹³×3.45×10⁷×2.24×10⁻³/15.49 ≈ 1.91 nm·rad。TPS 實際 1.6 nm·rad 對應因子 F = ε/(C_qγ²θ³) ≈ 0.054，介於 DBA 下限 0.0645 與 TME 0.0215 之間；ε_y/ε_x = 16 pm/1.6 nm = 1%。
knowledge.textEn: The strict-achromat DBA emittance floor is ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x). With γ = 5871, θ = 0.1309 rad, C_q = 3.832×10⁻¹³ m and J_x = 1, ε ≈ 3.832×10⁻¹³×3.45×10⁷×2.24×10⁻³/15.49 ≈ 1.91 nm·rad. The actual 1.6 nm·rad corresponds to F = ε/(C_qγ²θ³) ≈ 0.054, between the DBA floor of 0.0645 and the TME value of 0.0215; ε_y/ε_x = 16 pm/1.6 nm = 1%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance", which statement holds?
options: 嚴格消色散的 DBA 發射度下限為 ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x)。
只要提高射頻電壓，束流壽命就一定會延長。
頂注只是操作上的方便，對光束線的熱穩定沒有影響。
optionsEn: The strict-achromat DBA emittance floor is ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x).
Raising RF voltage always lengthens beam lifetime.
Top-up is merely an operational convenience with no effect on beamline thermal stability.
quiz.explanation: 嚴格消色散的 DBA 發射度下限為 ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The strict-achromat DBA emittance floor is ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「24 個雙彎消色散單元」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “24 double-bend achromat cells” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以軌道響應矩陣擬合（LOCO 類方法）求實際 β 函數與色散，再用 X 光針孔相機量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推發射度並與 1.6 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測直線段色散，確認其大小符合設計；以斜四極掃描量測耦合與垂直發射度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit the orbit-response matrix (LOCO-type analysis) to obtain actual beta functions and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole camera and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 1.6 nm·rad; measure straight-section dispersion with RF-frequency steps to confirm its design value; scan skew quadrupoles to measure coupling and vertical emittance. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：低發射度晶格需要很強的色品校正六極，動力孔徑隨之縮小；若六極設定或磁鐵誤差使動力孔徑再減，注入效率與 Touschek 壽命同時下降，頂注頻率被迫提高，輻射劑量與注入擾動跟著增加。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A low-emittance lattice needs strong chromatic sextupoles that shrink the dynamic aperture; if sextupole settings or magnet errors shrink it further, injection efficiency and Touschek lifetime fall together, top-up must run more often, and radiation dose and injection disturbances rise with it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以軌道響應矩陣擬合（LOCO 類方法）求實際 β 函數與色散，再用 X 光針孔相機量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推發射度並與 1.6 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測直線段色散，確認其大小符合設計；以斜四極掃描量測耦合與垂直發射度。
knowledge.textEn: Fit the orbit-response matrix (LOCO-type analysis) to obtain actual beta functions and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole camera and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 1.6 nm·rad; measure straight-section dispersion with RF-frequency steps to confirm its design value; scan skew quadrupoles to measure coupling and vertical emittance.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以軌道響應矩陣擬合（LOCO 類方法）求實際 β 函數與色散，再用 X 光針孔相機量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推發射度並與 1.6 nm·rad 比較。
波盪器只能在基頻工作，高能 X 光必須靠更高的電子能量。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Fit the orbit-response matrix (LOCO-type analysis) to obtain actual beta functions and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole camera and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 1.6 nm·rad.
An undulator works only at its fundamental, so hard X-rays require higher electron energy.
quiz.explanation: 以軌道響應矩陣擬合（LOCO 類方法）求實際 β 函數與色散，再用 X 光針孔相機量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推發射度並與 1.6 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測直線段色散，確認其大小符合設計；以斜四極掃描量測耦合與垂直發射度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit the orbit-response matrix (LOCO-type analysis) to obtain actual beta functions and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole camera and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 1.6 nm·rad; measure straight-section dispersion with RF-frequency steps to confirm its design value; scan skew quadrupoles to measure coupling and vertical emittance. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「24 個雙彎消色散單元」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “24 double-bend achromat cells” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 低發射度晶格需要很強的色品校正六極，動力孔徑隨之縮小；若六極設定或磁鐵誤差使動力孔徑再減，注入效率與 Touschek 壽命同時下降，頂注頻率被迫提高，輻射劑量與注入擾動跟著增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A low-emittance lattice needs strong chromatic sextupoles that shrink the dynamic aperture; if sextupole settings or magnet errors shrink it further, injection efficiency and Touschek lifetime fall together, top-up must run more often, and radiation dose and injection disturbances rise with it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：垂直發射度 16 pm·rad，對應約 1% 的耦合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The vertical emittance of 16 pm·rad corresponds to about 1% coupling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低發射度晶格需要很強的色品校正六極，動力孔徑隨之縮小；若六極設定或磁鐵誤差使動力孔徑再減，注入效率與 Touschek 壽命同時下降，頂注頻率被迫提高，輻射劑量與注入擾動跟著增加。
knowledge.textEn: A low-emittance lattice needs strong chromatic sextupoles that shrink the dynamic aperture; if sextupole settings or magnet errors shrink it further, injection efficiency and Touschek lifetime fall together, top-up must run more often, and radiation dose and injection disturbances rise with it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
四極磁鐵只要梯度正確，位置偏一點也沒關係。
低發射度晶格需要很強的色品校正六極，動力孔徑隨之縮小。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
If a quadrupole's gradient is correct, a small position offset does not matter.
A low-emittance lattice needs strong chromatic sextupoles that shrink the dynamic aperture.
quiz.explanation: 低發射度晶格需要很強的色品校正六極，動力孔徑隨之縮小；若六極設定或磁鐵誤差使動力孔徑再減，注入效率與 Touschek 壽命同時下降，頂注頻率被迫提高，輻射劑量與注入擾動跟著增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A low-emittance lattice needs strong chromatic sextupoles that shrink the dynamic aperture; if sextupole settings or magnet errors shrink it further, injection efficiency and Touschek lifetime fall together, top-up must run more often, and radiation dose and injection disturbances rise with it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
